parsed.summary: Router r1 serves as a gateway for the client segment (10.0.1.0/24) and connects to router r2 via a 30-bit link. It forwards traffic to remote segments (10.0.2.0/24, 10.0.99.0/24, and 10.0.4.0/24) through r2. It also enforces a firewall rule that drops traffic from the client segment to the 10.0.99.0/24 segment.
